vendor/model.js, vendor/rule.js and vendor/RuleBgCasual.js
are quasoft's backgammonjs engine, wrapped as classic scripts (the
GifOS runtime drops type=module). The Node crypto die roll is
crypto.getRandomValues. Console noise from the search is silenced.
Do not "improve" the rules — the table is the one that shipped with
backgammonjs (RuleBgCasual, general / standard, no doubling cube).

upstream: https://github.com/quasoft/backgammonjs
commit:   f85f6ff0b0af9efcc5ef98a6d7bf7fc140090782
date:     2025-06-09
license:  MIT (COPYING-backgammonjs.txt)

Pinned files wrapped:
  lib/model.js              → vendor/model.js
  lib/rules/rule.js         → vendor/rule.js
  lib/rules/RuleBgCasual.js → vendor/RuleBgCasual.js

NOT copied:
  lib/client.js / lib/comm.js     — socket.io client; we have no game server
  app/server/                     — their Node server
  app/browser/                    — jQuery / Bootstrap / bundle UI; rewritten
  lib/rules/RuleBgGulbara.js      — a different variant
  lib/rules/RuleBgTapa.js         — a different variant
